== Biography ==
Agnes was born about 1837 in Gortereghy, Rasharkin. She is the daughter of [[McCarnagh-1|John McCarnagh]] and [[Gormley-840|Mary Gormley]].


In the 1851 census Abstract for County Antrim, Agnes (age 14) was the daughter of John McCarnagh.<ref>

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Nancy McCaughern. The 1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory lists Nancy McCaughern as a publican among the inhabitants of Rasharkin. Her identity with Nancy Glasgow or the Nancy McCaughern named on James McCaughern’s memorial is unproved; the directory supplies no age or family connection.<ref>1912 Belfast and Ulster Directory, Rasharkin; [https://lennonwylie.co.uk/PT191214.htm record].</ref> Inspected named transcription or derivative source; original record uninspected and family identity not established. The identification remains uncertain.
